name: Stripe payment -> HubSpot deal sync
description: When a Stripe payment succeeds, upsert the paying customer as a HubSpot contact and create a deal marked closed-won with the payment amount. Failures must go to a Slack #payments-alerts message.
requirements: Idempotent: re-delivered Stripe events must not create duplicate HubSpot deals
Map stripe customer email -> hubspot contact email (upsert)
Deal amount from payment_intent.amount (convert from cents)
On any node failure, send Slack message to #payments-alerts with the Stripe event id
notes: The product name lives in payment_intent.metadata.product. If metadata.product is missing, decide a sensible fallback and flag it.
